hero.title: Menya Neza Amategeko y'Umuhanda mu Rwanda
hero.subtitle: Ibibazo by'imyitozo, umwarimu wa AI, igerageza rya 3D, n'ibyemezo byemewe

features.title: Ibintu Byose Ukeneye kugira ngo Utsinde
features.sub: Ibikoresho byizewe byateguwe kugira ngo bigufashe gusobanukirwa neza amategeko y'umuhanda mu Rwanda
features.quizzes_desc: Suzuma ubumenyi bwawe ukoresheje ibibazo bipimwa igihe bishingiye ku mategeko nyayo y'umuhanda mu Rwanda.
features.simulation_desc: Wimenyereze uko witwara mu muhanda mu buryo bw'amashusho ya 3D agaragaza ibintu nk'aho ari ukuri.
features.ai_desc: Bona ibisubizo ako kanya bitanzwe n'umwarimu wawe ugufasha kwiga gutwara ibinyabiziga mu Rwanda.
features.resources_desc: Bona inyandiko za PDF, amashusho, n'amafoto by'ibyapa n'amategeko y'umuhanda.

courses_section.title: Amasomo Yacu
courses_section.description: Amasomo ateguye neza yateguwe na Moto Sensei. Kuva ku by'ibanze by'amategeko kugeza ku bumenyi bwo hejuru bwo gutwara.

ai_section.title: Menyana na Moto-Sensei
ai_section.description: Umwarimu wawe wa AI ugufasha kwiga gutwara. Baza ibibazo mu Kinyarwanda, uhabwe ibisobanuro ako kanya, kandi umenye amategeko y'umuhanda vuba cyane.
ai_section.preview_greeting: Muraho! Ndi Moto-Sensei. Ni iki wifuza kwiga uyu munsi?
ai_section.preview_question: Icyapa gifite ishusho ya mpandeshatu itukura gisobanura iki?

flip.title: Amakarita y'Imyitozo ya Buri Munsi
flip.subtitle: Kwisubiramo byihuse amategeko n'ibyapa by'umuhanda by'ingenzi

blog_section.title: Soma Inyandiko Zacu Ziheruka
blog_section.desc: Komeza umenye inama zo gutwara, ubuyobozi ku mategeko y'umuhanda, n'amakuru y'uruhushya rwo gutwara — mu Cyongereza no mu Kinyarwanda.
blog_section.guide_title: Amategeko y'Umuhanda mu Rwanda: Ibyapa, Uruhushya, n'Umutekano
blog_section.guide_desc: Gutwara ikinyabiziga mu Rwanda bisaba gusobanukirwa neza amategeko y'umuhanda, uburyo ikoranabuhanga rikoreshwa mu kubungabunga umutekano.

certificate_section.title: Bona Icyemezo Cyemewe cya ISHAMI
certificate_section.description: Rangiza ikizamini cy'Amategeko y'Umuhanda n'Umutekano wo mu Muhanda uhabwe icyemezo cyemewe. Gisangize abakoresha, gicapishe, cyangwa ugenzure ukuri kwacyo kuri interineti. Garagaza ubumenyi bwawe bwo gutwara!

irembo_section.title: Ukeneye Ubufasha bwo Kwiyandikisha kuri Irembo?
irembo_section.description: Twagufasha kubona kode yo gukora ikizamini binyuze muri serivisi za Irembo. Ubufasha bwihuse, bwizewe, kandi butekanye.
irembo_section.fee: Ikiguzi cya Serivisi: 5,500 RWF | Igihe Bikorerwa: Mu masaha 8

leaderboard_section.title: Reba Abari ku Isonga
leaderboard_section.description: Reba abatsinze neza mu bizamini by'amategeko y'umuhanda mu Rwanda. Hatana, zamuka mu ntera, ugaragaze ubumenyi bwawe!

newsletter.title: Komeza Kumenya Amakuru
newsletter.desc: Bona inama ziheruka zo gutwara n'amakuru y'umuhanda byoherejwe muri imeyili yawe.
newsletter.success: ✓ Urakoze kwiyandikisha! Reba muri imeyili yawe kugira ngo wemeze.

developers_section.title: Wubake Ukoresheje ISHAMI API
developers_section.description: Injiza amategeko y'umuhanda, ibibazo, ibyapa, amasomo yuzuye na Moto Sensei AI (umwarimu w'umuhanda) muri porogaramu yawe — mu Kinyarwanda n'Icyongereza. Pro: 10,000 RWF/ukwezi.

cta.title: Witeguye Gutangira?
cta.subtitle: Fatanya n'ibihumbi by'Abanyarwanda barimo kumenya amategeko y'umuhanda bakoresheje ISHAMI
